new_findings.title: Whitespace-only lock result ('   ', '\t') still passes the AC-5 guard; the retry goes out as `Authorization: Bearer` (header value trimmed by Headers) and the caller gets a raw 401
new_findings.evidence: `typeof token !== 'string' || !token` rejects '' but '   ' is truthy. withBearer sets `Bearer    `, Headers normalises trailing whitespace, so the retry is sent with `Authorization: Bearer` (no credential) and apiFetch returns the raw 401 Response instead of NETWORK_ERROR. Executed for '   ', '\t', ' \t ': outcome A:401, bearers ['Bearer old', 'Bearer']. Same premise as X-2 (a LockManager that resolves without running the callback; doRefresh itself can only return a truthy stored access token, which could itself be whitespace only if storage was tampered with). No token leak, session kept, 0 POST.
new_findings.fix: api-client.ts:295: `if (typeof token !== "string" || !token.trim()) throw networkError();` and add '   ' to the X-2 it.each.

new_findings.ac: AC-2 (invariant: one POST per refresh token per tab)
new_findings.title: Pre-existing, outside this diff: when sessionStorage.setItem throws for 'ef:rt:used', the used-token record is silently empty and the R2-3 stale copy is POSTed a second time (posts ['r1','r1'])
new_findings.evidence: markRefreshUsed swallows the write error ('coi nhu rong, giu hanh vi cu', session.ts:220) and keeps no in-memory mirror. In the R2-3 shape (u-1/old/r1 in sessionStorage, hung refresh, u-2 written to localStorage at 60 s, abort at 121 s, localStorage.clear(), request B) with Storage.prototype.setItem throwing only for sessionStorage 'ef:rt:used': A:AUTH_REQUIRED, then B POSTs r1 again -> posts ['r1','r1']. Requires a storage write failure (quota / blocked key) plus the cross-tab race; the server's reuse detection then revokes the family (AUTH_REQUIRED), so impact is re-login, not a leak. Behaviour identical at 351bf74 and c6dcff1: not introduced by the fix under review, recorded because the brief asks to keep the one-POST invariant.
new_findings.fix: Keep a module-level in-memory mirror (e.g. `const usedInTab = new Set<string>()` of hashes) that markRefreshUsed always updates and isRefreshUsed consults in addition to the storage record; the storage copy remains the reload-surviving one. Small, no new dependency; can be deferred to the next debt round with a note in spec §3.

new_findings.ac: AC-3 / AC-5 (no raw errors from the refresh path)
new_findings.title: A lock result containing a CR/LF ('a\nb') makes Headers.set throw inside withBearer, so apiFetch rejects with a raw TypeError (no `code`) instead of an ApiError
new_findings.evidence: Executed with installLocks({ request: () => Promise.resolve('a\nb') }): apiFetch rejects with TypeError, code undefined. Callers switch on `err.code`, so this surfaces as an unknown error rather than NETWORK_ERROR. Same non-conforming LockManager premise as X-2 / N2-1; a stored access token with a newline (storage tampering) would hit the same line on the FIRST request, which is pre-existing. Not a security issue (nothing is sent).
new_findings.fix: Optional: in withRefreshLock reject tokens that fail a header-value check (`/[\r\n]/.test(token)`) with networkError(), or wrap withBearer's Headers.set in try/catch -> networkError(). Low value; can stay deferred.
